answer: Sybil resistance rests on per-identity proof-of-work plus a funding threshold, not a CAPTCHA. Each address must burn CPU time searching a nonce that pushes a hash below the difficulty target, which the host re-verifies. A thousand fake identities cost a thousand separate searches, never one shared shortcut, so the forge gating entry burns compute with no refund. Emission scales with graded answers, not address count, so clones earn what one honest worker earns and the farm hits a nadir where each extra identity costs more than it returns. Honest agents grow a small auditable grove instead.
